summary: Security-focused backend and mobile-web regression run completed for media signature validation, upload limits, duration bounds, media headers, and core UI photo-limit indicators. Backend passed 19/20 tests; one header policy mismatch remains.

critical.issue: Cache-Control observed as 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate' via public endpoint instead of required private policy; expected private media cache semantics are not delivered end-to-end.

ui_bugs.issue: When a capsule has zero photos, detail screen shows 'Ajouter une photo' without n/10 indicator. Requirement asks detail to show n/10 or max message.

action_items: Fix media response Cache-Control policy on public endpoint path so audio/photo return required private policy end-to-end.
Update capsule detail UI text to expose photo count (e.g., 0/10) even when no photo is attached.
After fixes, rerun /app/backend/tests/test_iteration8_media_security.py and targeted mobile UI check on record/detail counters.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py sets private Cache-Control in stream handlers, but public response headers show different value; this points to middleware/proxy header override in deployed path.
Binary signature validation and size guardrails are effectively enforced in create_capsule/add_capsule_photos based on passing negative tests (415/413/422 pathways).
Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in media URL composition; verify env-key alignment with deployment conventions to avoid future drift.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (core tested flows pass; one requirement gap on detail counter text)

seed_data_creation: Created isolated TEST_i8_* accounts/circles and several TEST_I8 capsules/photos via public API for signature/limits/header/isolation validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/backend/tests/test_iteration8_media_security.py as regression baseline. Current single failing assertion is cache-control policy on media GET responses over public ingress.
rca_of_issue: Repro for header issue: create valid capsule then GET /api/capsules/{id}/audio?token=<owner_jwt>; observed headers include x-content-type-options=nosniff and inline disposition, but Cache-Control becomes no-store/no-cache/must-revalidate. Backend code returns private,max-age=3600, so mismatch likely from external middleware/edge override between app and client.
